info.text: During a specialist initiated initial call the identification of the aircraft can be accomplished in two ways: » State the prefix "November" when establishing initial communications with U.S. registered aircraft followed by the phonetic pronunciation of the numbers/letters of the aircraft registration » The specialist may state the aircraft type, model, or manufacturer’s name, followed by the phonetic pronunciation of the numbers/letters of the aircraft registration if used by the pilot on the initial or subsequent call.
EXAMPLE 1: "November Three Four Seven Seven Papa, Fort Worth Radio."
EXAMPLE 2: "Cessna Three Four Seven Seven Papa, Fort Worth Radio."
